title.description:
Title to display with the tile. The {@link #view#name} will be displayed with this title when selected.
Can be a {@link Translation} key.

views.description:
All possible views for the tile. Generally should be different ways to view the same, or very similar, data to
answer related questions.

title: A representation of a panel or chart space in a dashboard
name: App.Metric.Dashboard.Tile
